features.name: FastAPI app + router wiring
features.detail: FastAPI(title='PersonalSong Studio', version='2.2.0'). Imports env_setup first (FFmpeg DLLs on PATH), load_dotenv(), ensures music_library/ exists, then mounts 12 routers under /api/* (lyrics, audio, library, config, media, source, extras, voices, batch, prompt, ytmusic). Serves static/index.html at / and /health -> {status: ok}.

features.name: In-process uvicorn launcher
features.detail: Runs uvicorn.run('main:app', host=0.0.0.0, port=8088, reload=False) IN-PROCESS so the server uses THIS venv (which has acestep). 'python -m uvicorn' spawned a child on base Python lacking acestep. Asserts `import acestep` before serving.

features.name: QI_PersonalSong NSSM service
features.detail: Installs service QI_PersonalSong -> .venv\Scripts\python.exe serve.py, AppDirectory C:\PersonalSong, SERVICE_DEMAND_START, rotating logs at logs\service.log. Uses the standardized C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe. PersonalSong_Start_Server.bat is the manual equivalent.

features.name: Shared FFmpeg-on-PATH bootstrap
features.detail: Prepends ffmpeg_shared/v71/.../bin (FFmpeg 7.1 shared DLLs) to PATH so torchcodec (torchaudio.load/save in torch 2.11) loads; without it Demucs/Seed-VC fail with 'libtorchcodec_core7.dll could not be loaded'. Applied on import; subprocesses inherit PATH.

features.name: POST /api/lyrics/generate
features.detail: Builds a structured prompt, calls Ollama /api/generate with think=False (qwen3 emits lyrics instead of burning budget on reasoning -> empty response) and keep_alive=0 (unload model to free VRAM for ACE-Step). Strips <think> blocks. 503 on connect/404 model, 504 on timeout.

features.name: Duration-scaled song structure
features.detail: Maps target seconds to a section layout (<=35s verse+chorus .. >130s intro/verse/pre-chorus/chorus/bridge/verse3/final-chorus/outro). Prompt enforces the exact name appears >=2x including the chorus, short singable lines, lyrics-only output. Handles blend mode + anthem (country/team) framing.

features.name: GET /api/lyrics/models
features.detail: Lists installed Ollama models from /api/tags for the settings picker; returns online flag. Default model qwen3:8b (configurable via OLLAMA_MODEL / app_config).

features.name: Lazy singleton pipeline
features.detail: Thread-locked lazy-load of ACEStepPipeline(checkpoint_dir=None auto-download, dtype='bfloat16', torch_compile=False, cpu_offload=False). Resident in VRAM across requests. Patches torchaudio.save to write via soundfile (libsndfile) to bypass missing TorchCodec FFmpeg DLLs on Windows.

features.name: generate_song()
features.detail: Core call: pipe(audio_duration, prompt=tags, lyrics, infer_step=60, guidance_scale=7.5, scheduler='euler', cfg_type='apg', use_erg_*=True, manual_seeds, audio2audio_enable + ref_audio_strength when a reference is given, save_path). Returns save_path.

features.name: Style-tag builder
features.detail: Composes the ACE prompt: vocal gender FIRST (weighted), genre tag(s), singer voice descriptor, mood, language conditioning, 'studio quality'. Curated tag dicts for ~30 genres incl. Brazilian/Japanese/French styles; unknown genres get a best-effort expansion. Genres + languages may be lists (blend).

features.name: Lyric normalization + name injection
features.detail: normalize_lyrics strips <think>, maps headers to lowercase [verse]/[chorus]/etc, drops prose. ensure_name_in_lyrics injects the name as a vocative into chorus/verse if absent. apply_pronunciation swaps the name for its respelling ONLY in the sung text (display lyrics keep the real name).

features.name: Sung-gender verification
features.detail: Isolates the vocal with Demucs (forced CPU to avoid VRAM contention with the resident ACE-Step), estimates median f0 with librosa.pyin -> male/female/unknown. levers_to_ref_strength maps melody+feel change sliders (1..10) to ref_audio_strength (capped 0.80 so the model re-sings).

features.name: POST /api/audio/generate
features.detail: Resolves singer -> descriptor/seed/gender, builds tags, normalizes + injects name + applies respelling, frees Ollama VRAM, runs ACE-Step off the event loop in a single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor (serialized GPU). Transcodes WAV->MP3, optional dedication, writes a JSON sidecar, Plex sync + YT Music upload (both silent/optional).

features.name: Gender-locked retry
features.detail: When a specific gender is requested, generates, verifies via detect_gender(), and retries once with a fresh random seed if wrong (ACE's gender tag alone is unreliable). Bounded to 2 tries.

features.name: POST /api/audio/generate_based
features.detail: audio2audio remix from a source song steered by melody/lyrics/feel levers. Low lyrics-change transcribes the source via Whisper (asr.transcribe) and re-sings its words; otherwise uses provided lyrics. ref_strength from levers_to_ref_strength.

features.name: POST /api/audio/generate_cover
features.detail: Full voice-clone cover in the thread executor: ACE-Step base song -> ingest source voice -> cover.make_cover (Demucs x2 + Seed-VC + mix). Saves final + JSON, syncs to Plex/YT.

features.name: GET /api/audio/stream/{song_id}
features.detail: Finds the song's metadata sidecar by song_id and streams the audio file via FileResponse.

features.name: Demucs stem separation
features.detail: Runs `python -m demucs --two-stems vocals -n htdemucs -d <device>` as a subprocess in the venv. Returns {vocals, instrumental} paths (htdemucs/<track>/vocals.wav + no_vocals.wav). device='cpu' avoids VRAM contention with a resident GPU model.

features.name: Source acquisition
features.detail: yt-dlp bestaudio->WAV from a URL; copy a local audio file; persist an upload (video -> audio extracted via ffmpeg); extract_audio trims/transcodes any media to MP3. Sources saved under a configurable sources/ folder.

features.name: CD ripping
features.detail: Detects optical drives via WMI (PowerShell), checks for a libcdio-enabled gyan ffmpeg build, lists tracks (chapters), and rips all/one track to MP3. Gracefully reports when the libcdio build is absent.

features.name: WAV->MP3 transcode
features.detail: ffmpeg libmp3lame 192k -q:a 2; smaller + reliable for browser/Plex/Google Home; deletes the WAV on success.

features.name: POST /api/source/* router
features.detail: /list, /upload, /url, /local (audio or video w/ optional trim), /drives, /cd/tracks, /cd/rip. Validates input and surfaces ffmpeg/yt-dlp failures as HTTP errors.

features.name: Cover orchestrator
features.detail: make_cover: Demucs(source)->ref voice + orig instrumental; Demucs(ACE song)->its vocals+instrumental; seedvc_convert(ACE vocals -> source voice) with --f0-condition True (singing); mix over chosen backing. Seed-VC runs in its OWN venv (seed-vc/.venv) as a subprocess to isolate incompatible deps.

features.name: Spoken-dedication clone
features.detail: Isolates a vocal-rich 30s slice of the artist's song (Demucs, GPU->CPU fallback) and re-voices the spoken dedication via Seed-VC (--f0-condition False for speech, --fp16 True). Separate Seed-VC venv driven as a subprocess with a 900s timeout.

features.name: Native-voice dedication renderer
features.detail: edge-tts neural voices per language (8 langs, male/female). draft_text composes native wording per [style][language][tone] (radio/concert x heartfelt/warm/festive) with a sender tail. Prosody (rate/pitch) preset per tone+style. edge-tts async is run in a dedicated thread (safe inside the FastAPI loop). Optional Seed-VC clone_ref re-voices into the artist's timbre.

features.name: Concert ambience + prepend
features.detail: Synthesizes a subtle crowd/applause bed (numpy) for concert style. prepend_to_song puts the spoken intro before the song with a gap + fade. add_dedication drafts->renders->prepends and replaces the song file in place.

features.name: POST /api/media/* (mic & dedication)
features.detail: /transcribe-name (Whisper -> heard text + suggested respelling), /pronounce-preview (hear a respelling spoken in the target language), /dedication-draft, /add-dedication (prepend a spoken intro to an ALREADY-finished uploaded song, optionally mimicking the artist's voice; song audio untouched).

features.name: Persistent config + dictionaries
features.detail: JSON-backed config under config/ (app_config.json) with thread-locked save and folder auto-creation. Holds pronunciations.json (per-language respellings), singers.json (10 presets), voices.json (saved reference clips), queue.json (overnight queue). DEFAULTS include paths, Plex creds, ollama_model qwen3:8b, default language/genres/duration.

features.name: POST/GET /api/config/* + /api/voices/*
features.detail: Settings CRUD, pronunciation CRUD (per language), singers CRUD, Plex status/sections probes, and a named reference-voice library for reuse in voice cloning.

features.name: Library + extras
features.detail: library: list/stream/delete songs (scans music_library/*.json, skips ACE _input_params sidecars), GPU/ACE-ready settings probe. extras: cover art generate/serve, MP3 download, share-bundle zip, karaoke stems zip, mobile play page, printable QR greeting card.

features.name: Cover-art engine
features.detail: PIL gradient cover (genre palette + radial glow + music note + name/occasion) always works instantly. ai_cover runs SDXL-Turbo in a subprocess (own VRAM, freed on exit; imports StableDiffusionXLPipeline directly to dodge diffusers' flux2/transformers pin conflict with ACE-Step). Falls back to procedural on any error.

features.name: YouTube Music manager
features.detail: Browser-header auth (ytmusicapi.setup) saved to config/ytmusic_headers.json; lazy thread-safe client. Upload one / all-from-library (background task), list/delete uploads, playlist CRUD, auto-upload toggle. Live code but inactive until headers are pasted once.

features.name: Plex sync
features.detail: _sync_to_plex tags the finished MP3 (ID3) and copies it to the Plex-watched folder, then triggers a section scan; reads Plex creds from app_config. check_connection/list_sections power the Settings probes. Built but needs a Plex token + music section id configured; never blocks the song.

features.name: Whisper ASR (shared)
features.detail: Lazy singleton whisper 'base' model on cuda/cpu. Used by /transcribe-name (teach a name) and generate_based (transcribe a source song's lyrics when lyrics-change is low).

features.name: Prompt export
features.detail: Exports a ready-to-paste prompt/lyrics package for external generators (e.g. Suno) for users who skip the local pipeline.
